f1-immobiliare.public: Proprietari di immobili residenziali in Valle di Susa che stanno valutando la vendita o vogliono conoscere il valore reale dell'immobile
f1-immobiliare.main_message: Prima di vendere casa, il valore va verificato con dati, comparabili, microzona e domanda reale.

inventory.rule: The system first gathers potential posts from accounts the viewer follows and applies integrity filtering.
inventory.production_implication: Every asset must be policy-safe, truthful, coherent and designed for an identifiable audience.

signals.rule: The ranking system considers multiple input signals about the creator, media type, viewer relationship and current post.
signals.production_implication: Do not optimize for a single vanity metric. Evaluate audience relevance, media fit, prior comparable performance and meaningful actions together.

predictions.rule: Models predict which content a person may find most useful and relevant.
predictions.production_implication: Before creation define one precise audience, one objective and one main message with a clear reason to stop, consume and act.

ranking_score.rule: The system scores eligible posts for relevance and orders them; it also seeks a useful mix of content types.
ranking_score.production_implication: Score drafts against the full prediction set and maintain creative/format variety instead of repeating one pattern.

signals: how often the viewer advances to the next card
number of carousel units viewed
whether the carousel was reordered in Feed
whether the post is recommended
number of units in the carousel
creative_rules: Card 1 must create a precise reason to continue.
Every card must add new information and create a logical reason to swipe.
Do not pad the carousel with redundant slides.
The final card must close the information loop or present one coherent next action.

signals: positive actions such as like, comment or reshare
time spent on the post
media type used to estimate expected viewing time
creative_rules: Create something meaningful for the selected audience, not generic engagement bait.
Make the subject immediately recognizable.
Use the media format that best serves the message rather than forcing every idea into one format.

signals: whether the post is photo, video or carousel
relative probability of skipping this post versus adjacent posts
creative_rules: Remove weak introductions.
Put the relevant subject, problem, desire, result or information in the first visible unit.
Avoid generic stock-like, confusing, blurred or visually unrelated assets.
Keep visual text short and immediately readable.

signals: time spent on the creator profile
whether the post is recommended
profile visit after viewing the post
creative_rules: Make brand identity visible without overwhelming the content.
Create enough credibility or curiosity that the target has a reason to inspect the profile.
Keep the post coherent with profile positioning so the transition to the profile makes sense.

signals: whether content is informational such as news, reviews, tutorials or instructions
recency of the post within 90 days
whether it is a repost or organic repost
opening the share sheet and selecting a recipient
whether the post is recommended
creative_rules: Prefer useful information people may naturally send to another person when appropriate.
Do not ask for meaningless shares; make the information itself share-worthy.
Use current, relevant and specific information when the subject is time-sensitive.

signals: for photos, amount of overlaid text
viewer Reels watch-time group
whether the post is recommended
time spent on the post
recent reshare-button use in the previous 28 days
creative_rules: For photos, do not overload the image with text.
Use one primary visual message and move explanation to the caption when necessary.
Design content so useful attention is rewarded rather than created through confusion.

signals: whether the first post was actually viewed
time spent on the first post
whether an action occurred
whether the post is first in Feed
creative_rules: Assume every post may be the first item a follower sees.
The first visible unit must work without prior context.
Do not rely on a slow setup to explain why the content matters.

signals: whether the post is recommended
whether viewing time reaches 10 seconds
total viewing time including Reels shown in Feed
creative_rules: Create a strong first 1-3 seconds and a reason to continue beyond the hook.
Do not reveal only the hook and then repeat it; add progressive value.
For video, structure the middle so the viewer has a reason to stay beyond 10 seconds.

signals: whether the post is recommended
whether the viewer enables audio
whether the post is video/Reel
creative_rules: Design audio intentionally with music, voiceover or sound effects when rights permit.
The content must remain understandable with captions/context even if audio is not activated.
Audio should support the message rather than exist as decoration.

signals: whether the post is first in Feed
whether it was viewed for at least 3 seconds
time spent in the rest of the session after the first post
creative_rules: Optimize the first impression for immediate relevance and low confusion.
Avoid clickbait that disappoints after the first seconds.
Deliver value quickly enough that the post contributes positively to the viewing session.

signals: recency of photo/video capture
capture location
whether media was favorited
presence of people or animals
gallery_suggestion_metadata.production_implication: When the user has granted Instagram access to owned gallery metadata, these fields may help organize candidate media for Stories, posts or Reels. They are selection metadata, not proof that an asset will rank well.
gallery_suggestion_metadata.privacy_rule: Do not infer private or sensitive traits from people present in media.

reels_creative_essentials.audio: Use intentional audio when rights permit; keep the message understandable without audio.
reels_creative_essentials.safe_area: Keep the bottom 35% free of essential creative elements, text and logos so interface overlays do not obscure the message.
reels_creative_essentials.message: Keep primary messages inside the safe area.
reels_creative_essentials.first_frame: The first frame/first 1-3 seconds must make the subject and value understandable immediately.
reels_creative_essentials.captions: Use captions/subtitles when they improve context, clarity and accessibility.
reels_creative_essentials.brand: Show the brand clearly and coherently, especially for conversion-oriented Reels.
reels_creative_essentials.harmony: Use visually coherent clips/assets; avoid mixing unrelated styles and shooting conditions without a reason.
reels_creative_essentials.production_quality: Professional-only footage is not required; phone footage is acceptable when clear, coherent and useful.

do: show special offers only when genuine and relevant
use a clear purchase/action CTA when the objective is conversion
dont: mix footage created at very different times/styles without coherence
assume only professionally shot footage can work

do: show the value of taking the action immediately
build the Reel toward the final action
dont: focus only on lifestyle or atmosphere when the objective is a measurable action

team_expertise: close with a clear next step

reels_editing.animate_static_images: Use movement/transitions when turning static images into Reels, but movement must improve viewing rather than distract.
reels_editing.subtitles: Add subtitles/captions to contextualize, clarify and improve accessibility.
reels_editing.cutout: Background removal/cutout may be used to emphasize subjects, text or alternate backgrounds when coherent.

rules: Use AI to scale what already works, renew creative faster and reuse existing assets.
Generated text variants must be based on brand tone and prior high-performing comparable content when such data exists.
Convert existing video to 9:16 without damaging the subject or brand coherence.
AI output remains subject to the same quality, truthfulness, brand, integrity and rights checks as manually produced media.

creators_best_practices.name: Instagram Creators Engaging Content Best Practices

engagement_definition.rule: Create content that earns meaningful interactions rather than generic engagement bait.

trial_reels.profile_visibility: not shown on profile or to followers during trial
trial_reels.rule: Use trial Reels to test new concepts, characters and styles before wider distribution when the account is eligible.

format_diversification.rule: Use a mix of formats instead of repeating one format automatically; choose format based on the message, target and objective.

creative_effects.rule: Use creative effects only when they improve storytelling, clarity or interaction.

audio.rights_rule: Use only audio you are licensed or otherwise permitted to use.
audio.purpose: Use music and sound to create atmosphere, meaning or pacing; never as decoration only.

reach_audience_directly.rule: When useful, ask the audience directly what matters to them using authentic feedback mechanisms such as comments, DMs, Stories, channels, live sessions or polls.

engagement_bait.rule: Do not ask for artificial or meaningless interactions intended only to inflate engagement or reach.
examples_to_avoid: Commenta SI senza valore rispetto al contenuto
Tagga persone senza una ragione utile
Condividi seguendo formule manipolative o superstiziose
Inviti a cliccare o condividere che non aggiungono valore al contenuto

actions: reply to a Reel comment with a Reel when useful
comment_interaction.rule: Keep the conversation alive by liking or replying to comments in the first days after publication; a relevant Reel reply may be used when it adds value.

reels_best_practices.rule: Reels must capture attention immediately, remain understandable without sound, and be built to create natural sharing and conversation.

instagram.rule: Use actual account/page data when present. Never fabricate ranking performance, watch-time, skip, share, save, profile-visit or audio metrics.

publication_timing.rule: Use actual Page/Instagram Insights audience-online data. Never invent a best time.

whether the post is video/Reel
creative_rules: Design audio intentionally with music, voiceover or sound effects when rights permit.
The content must remain understandable with captions/context even if audio is not activated.
Audio should support the message rather than exist as decoration.

signals: whether the post is first in Feed
whether it was viewed for at least 3 seconds
time spent in the rest of the session after the first post
creative_rules: Optimize the first impression for immediate relevance and low confusion.
Avoid clickbait that disappoints after the first seconds.
Deliver value quickly enough that the post contributes positively to the viewing session.

signals: recency of photo/video capture
capture location
whether media was favorited
presence of people or animals
gallery_suggestion_metadata.production_implication: When the user has granted Instagram access to owned gallery metadata, these fields may help organize candidate media for Stories, posts or Reels. They are selection metadata, not proof that an asset will rank well.
gallery_suggestion_metadata.privacy_rule: Do not infer private or sensitive traits from people present in media.

reels_creative_essentials.audio: Use intentional audio when rights permit; keep the message understandable without audio.
reels_creative_essentials.safe_area: Keep the bottom 35% free of essential creative elements, text and logos so interface overlays do not obscure the message.
reels_creative_essentials.message: Keep primary messages inside the safe area.
reels_creative_essentials.first_frame: The first frame/first 1-3 seconds must make the subject and value understandable immediately.
reels_creative_essentials.captions: Use captions/subtitles when they improve context, clarity and accessibility.
reels_creative_essentials.brand: Show the brand clearly and coherently, especially for conversion-oriented Reels.
reels_creative_essentials.harmony: Use visually coherent clips/assets; avoid mixing unrelated styles and shooting conditions without a reason.
reels_creative_essentials.production_quality: Professional-only footage is not required; phone footage is acceptable when clear, coherent and useful.

do: show special offers only when genuine and relevant
use a clear purchase/action CTA when the objective is conversion
dont: mix footage created at very different times/styles without coherence
assume only professionally shot footage can work

do: show the value of taking the action immediately
build the Reel toward the final action
dont: focus only on lifestyle or atmosphere when the objective is a measurable action

team_expertise: close with a clear next step

reels_editing.animate_static_images: Use movement/transitions when turning static images into Reels, but movement must improve viewing rather than distract.
reels_editing.subtitles: Add subtitles/captions to contextualize, clarify and improve accessibility.
reels_editing.cutout: Background removal/cutout may be used to emphasize subjects, text or alternate backgrounds when coherent.

rules: Use AI to scale what already works, renew creative faster and reuse existing assets.
Generated text variants must be based on brand tone and prior high-performing comparable content when such data exists.
Convert existing video to 9:16 without damaging the subject or brand coherence.
AI output remains subject to the same quality, truthfulness, brand, integrity and rights checks as manually produced media.

creators_best_practices.name: Instagram Creators Engaging Content Best Practices

engagement_definition.rule: Create content that earns meaningful interactions rather than generic engagement bait.

trial_reels.profile_visibility: not shown on profile or to followers during trial
trial_reels.rule: Use trial Reels to test new concepts, characters and styles before wider distribution when the account is eligible.

format_diversification.rule: Use a mix of formats instead of repeating one format automatically; choose format based on the message, target and objective.

creative_effects.rule: Use creative effects only when they improve storytelling, clarity or interaction.

audio.rights_rule: Use only audio you are licensed or otherwise permitted to use.
audio.purpose: Use music and sound to create atmosphere, meaning or pacing; never as decoration only.

reach_audience_directly.rule: When useful, ask the audience directly what matters to them using authentic feedback mechanisms such as comments, DMs, Stories, channels, live sessions or polls.

engagement_bait.rule: Do not ask for artificial or meaningless interactions intended only to inflate engagement or reach.
examples_to_avoid: Commenta SI senza valore rispetto al contenuto
Tagga persone senza una ragione utile
Condividi seguendo formule manipolative o superstiziose
Inviti a cliccare o condividere che non aggiungono valore al contenuto

actions: reply to a Reel comment with a Reel when useful
comment_interaction.rule: Keep the conversation alive by liking or replying to comments in the first days after publication; a relevant Reel reply may be used when it adds value.

reels_best_practices.rule: Reels must capture attention immediately, remain understandable without sound, and be built to create natural sharing and conversation.

instagram.rule: Use actual account/page data when present. Never fabricate ranking performance, watch-time, skip, share, save, profile-visit or audio metrics.

publication_timing.rule: Use actual Page/Instagram Insights audience-online data. Never invent a best time.
